_comment: Lane D landing-zone front-door control map (Vol IX Book 02). Each catalog item binds to the NIST control it satisfies. Actuation is the CPG Terraform Connector via the in-boundary MID; every change is speculative-plan → approve/SoD → apply → validation gate → IPAM/DDI reconcile → close. Projection of orgcomp-compliance-spine.yml, CI-validated against it (slots, KSI themes, boundary, schema) by validate_day2_control_maps.py. Scope: FedRAMP Moderate + GCC Moderate.

lz.subscription.provision.title: Provision landing-zone subscription
lz.subscription.provision.note: Change-controlled IaC; deployed state equals reviewed source.

lz.subnet.allocate.title: Allocate subnet (DDI-backed)
lz.subnet.allocate.note: Address block reconciled to the authoritative IPAM/DDI record at allocation time — no allocation outside the naming plane.

lz.aws.instance.provision.title: Provision RedHat EC2 instance (AWS landing-zone front door)
lz.aws.instance.provision.note: Phase 5.4 (RedHat-on-AWS estate): the same speculative-plan -> approve/SoD -> apply -> validate loop as the Azure front door, applied to the AWS landing-zone pattern; the instance reconciles to IPAM/DDI and the CM-8 join key at provisioning, before anything downstream claims it.
lz.aws.instance.provision.actuator_gap: Phase 5.4 build-out (issue #1289): the AWS catalog->tfvars->CPG Terraform Connector wiring for EC2 provisioning lands with the RedHat-on-AWS estate work; declared here so the claim is visible backlog, not silent.

lz.aws.patchschedule.change.title: Change AWS patch schedule (SSM Patch Manager / Ansible)
lz.aws.patchschedule.change.note: Phase 5.4: maintenance-window / patch-baseline / AAP job-template changes for the RedHat-on-AWS estate as change-controlled catalog items feeding the Vol III Book 03 SI-2 queue — never an ad-hoc console edit.
lz.aws.patchschedule.change.actuator_gap: Phase 5.4 build-out (issue #1289): SSM maintenance-window and Ansible job-template actuation through the in-boundary MID lands with the RedHat-on-AWS estate work; until then the schedule change is a documented, approval-gated manual runbook.
